mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.16% (as of t-1mo) is historically low, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (3-month change > 0) and CPI is rising (3-month change > 0), the combination signals monetary tightening and accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS change * CPIAUCSL change) shows a positive correlation with negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5%), the unemployment rate is positively related to S&P 500 returns, meaning higher unemployment leads to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE is above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is positively related to S&P 500 returns, as strong housing activity signals a healthy economy and rising corporate earnings, producing positive returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of HOUST level with 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, increasing the risk of monetary tightening and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL is above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts are weak (HOUST < 700) and inflation is high (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the combination signals a deteriorating economy and rising inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: deteriorating economy and high inflation regime
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST < 700 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) shows a positive correlation with negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 95), the industrial production index is negatively related to S&P 500 returns, meaning weak supply activity leads to negative returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when INDPRO is below 95.
